originals.citation: International Parkinson Disease Genomics Consortium (Nalls, M. A., et al.) (2011). Imputation of sequence variants for identification of genetic risks for Parkinson's disease: a meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies. Lancet, 377, 641-649.

quote: Eleven genetic loci have reached genome-wide significance in a recent meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies in Parkinson disease (PD) based on populations of Caucasian descent.
notes: The 11 loci come from the Nalls et al. 2011 meta-analysis; some loci were first reported in earlier GWAS (Simon-Sanchez 2009, Satake 2009, Pankratz 2008, Hamza 2010), but the paper frames its re-test around the 2011 meta-analysis.
